messages:
talia: Heads-up  I'm working on an "impact card" for saved views that surfaces both aggregate route risk and an optional per-model worst-case. Goal: let PMs see likely token burn, an upper bound, and a confidence score before they hit commit. Need API naming and telemetry tags nailed down. Anyone have a minute?

owen: quick q: do we want to show a deterministic worst-case (max of variants) or a percentile (p95)? p95 might be better for noisy models.

talia: prefer p95 for user-facing upper bound, label it "estimated worst-case (p95)". also show an explicit "upper bound basis" badge explaining provenance.

marta: API needs to return both fast UI-friendly lines and a structured telemetry event. UI payload can be compact (CSV-ish) but telemetry must be structured. Also add `cache_adjustment` so previews don't double-count cached prefixes.

raj: infra: add stable span tags: `route`, `preset`, `preview_id`, `model`, `variant`, `preview_basis`, and `trace_key=console.presets.preview.v2`. We'll also emit `estimate_type` (aggregate|per-model|p95).

ops-bot: ops-bot: note: quota guardrail configured: warn if simulated commit would exceed 90% of route quota.

talia: sketch of the UI preview response (compact):
```json
{
  "preset_id":"pc-1888",
  "route":"route-77",
  "aggregate":"tokens:12000:cost:0.98:confidence:0.87",
  "models":"rwin-3:9000:0.74:p95,rwin-3-quant:3000:0.24:p95",
  "cache_adj":"0.12",
  "upper_bound":"p95",
  "preview_id":"pv-1888",
  "preview_basis":"14d_hist"
}
```

marta: for the saved presets API (authoritative) keep structured keys. example: `by_model` array, `preview_sample_window`, `confidence`, `cache_effect_adjustment`, `rollout_policy` with `canary_pct` and `fallback_variants`. console will call the compact preview endpoint for fast renders and the authoritative endpoint when simulating commit.

ownen: simulate-commit flow: modal shows post-commit quota delta, breakdown per model, and an orange pill if it would push route usage over 90%. include a small "dry-run traces" checkbox that attaches `preview_id` to traces for easy debugging.

raj: backend suggestion: two endpoints: `/v1/presets/preview/ui` -> compact CSV-ish, low-latency; `/v1/presets/preview/structured` -> full JSON for telemetry and simulate-commit. Both should emit `preview_id` and telemetry span with `trace_key`.

talia: rollout knobs: `rollout_policy:{"preference":"latency","canary_pct":0.05,"fallback_order":["rwin-3","rwin-3-quant"]}`. console should enforce `canary_pct <= 0.2` and surface a warning if user tries more.

marta: add `simulation_basis` field when running simulate-commit (e.g., "historical-14d" vs "synthetic-spot"). analytics will want that to join to billing tables.

raj: telemetry will include tags: `route:route-77`, `preset:pc-1888`, `preview_id:pv-1888`, `preview_basis:14d_hist`, `estimate_type:p95`, plus per-model tags in span events. we'll also include `quota_guardrail:90pct` when simulate is run.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: planning canary for presets-impact-card: 2025-06-09T05:00:00Z (team: eng-platform).

talia: action items: 1) owen - wire UI prototype with p95 upper bound and dry-run traces checkbox; 2) marta - implement compact `/preview/ui` and structured `/preview/structured` with cache_adj and sample_window; 3) raj - make sure trace_key and span tags are stable and present; 4) ops - confirm quota guardrail alert copy. sync Mon 9am PT to lock microcopy. short thread.
